guard/30725.htm.text: Guard Yening: Hello there, you seem like a fine sort. I'm Yening. Guard Yening. I was an adventurer not too long ago. I was recruited by some Mystics I met in the Sea of Spores which is why I'm currently working as a guard.

links.text: Ask about the Sea of Spores.
Ask if he has any good information.
See the Lord and get the tax rate information.

guard/30725-1.htm.text: Guard Yening: The Sea of Spores? Please don't mention that name! Even now it makes me uncomfortable. It is a foul place, glutted with rotten mushrooms, fungus and zombies roaming about. Honestly, you will not find another place like it. A war between Men and Elves a long time ago left the sea into …

guard/30725-2.htm.text: Guard Yening: You seek information? Well, if you've come to the Ivory Tower you must be interested in magic, am I right? If so, you should catch the monsters around here. I hear they are carrying High-level Spellbooks while roaming in the craters. These are very valuable and useful items.

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
